expectations.text: Identifies the NCA's draft AI Cybersecurity Guidelines (AICG-1:2026)
States the public consultation ran July 5 to August 5, 2026
expectations.evidence: "went through public consultation from 5 July to 5 August 2026"

expectations.text: Describes the draft: 4 domains, roughly 42 guidelines, covering generative and agentic AI
expectations.evidence: "The draft has 4 domains and about 42 guidelines and covers generative and agentic AI."

expectations.text: States the final version remains unpublished as of November 2026, so they are draft, not binding requirements
expectations.evidence: "As of November 2026 the final version is unpublished. Do not cite it as binding."

expectations.text: Advises monitoring the NCA and preparing against the draft structure
expectations.evidence: "Set up a watch on NCA and SDAIA publications, and plan a gap assessment once the AICG is final" plus "Treat the AICG draft as a design signal."
